reviewer: Claude Code (Opus 5.5) with a fresh-context medium reviewer subagent

claims.summary: Nested word rank saturation. Let w in Z^d be nested: the positions of its nonzero entries have a non-crossing perfect matching M into pairs u < v with w_u = -w_v (zero entries are singletons); fix M. Let X_1..X_d be disjoint sets of noncommuting variables with |X_i| = 2^|w_i|. Define the factor sequence S(w): the empty word gives the empty sequence, a concatenation of blocks the concatenation of their sequences, a singleton at i the label x_(i,1), and a matched block (u, W', v) with q = 2^|w_u| gives, for a = 1..q in turn, x_(u,a), then S(W'), then x_(v,a). The product P_w of the factors 1 + x in the order S(w), a formula of product-depth one with 0/1 coefficients, has ordered set-multilinear projection (the part on the monomials x_(1,a_1)...x_(d,a_d)) whose partial derivative matrix, rows the monomials over the parts with w_i > 0 and columns over those with w_i < 0, has integer entries and determinant 1 over Z in the orders of the proof; so it is invertible over every ring with 1 and has relative rank 1 over every field, F_2 included. The number of factors is s(w) = sum over zero positions of the product of 2^|w_u'| over the pairs enclosing them, plus 2 sum over pairs pi of the product of 2^|w_u'| over the pairs enclosing or equal to pi. For the words w_Delta of Tavenas-Limaye-Srinivasan (ECCC TR21-094, eq. (5); k >= 1, r >= 3 odd, d' = r^Delta - 1) padded with zeros to length d >= d', s <= d' 2^(k(2^Delta - 1)) + d - d' <= d N^2, N the number of variables.
claims.assessment: Working proof passed with corrections by a fresh-context medium reviewer in two rounds: (a) by chain counts, Kronecker products for concatenations and block triangular matrices for matched blocks, with determinant 1 over Z and the adjugate carried along Z -> R; (c) by induction on the matching; (d) by prefix sums of the TLS words, B_(i+1) = 2B_i + k. Computations over F_2 on eight nested words (full rank), committed before their runs. Nested words only; the reviewer's unit-step construction for every path is computed full rank on 135 small paths and unproved.
claims.rationale: The relative-rank measure of the Tavenas-Limaye-Srinivasan noncommutative lower bound, applied to ordered set-multilinear projections, is already 1 on a product of factors 1 + x over F_2 itself, of product-depth one and at most d N^2 factors, for the padded words that bound uses; so that bound, read for inhomogeneous formulas, fails over the goal's field without the large integral domain that FLST Proposition 24 needs. It generalizes the interleaved control of thm:affine-component-ranks, the case (1,-1)^r. Balanced words without a nested matching are not covered.
claims.next_action: Decide whether every path of P_{k,d} has a product over F_2 of at most poly(N) affine factors whose ordered set-multilinear projection is full rank, first by the unit-step refinement the reviewer proposed (unverified).

relationships: Its interleaved control, rank at least 2^r for the odd/even flattening of the degree-2r component of the product of 3r factors 1 + X_j, gives, after the substitution X_(3i-2) -> x_(2i-1,1), X_(3i-1) -> x_(2i-1,2) + x_(2i,1), X_(3i) -> x_(2i,2) computed in the entry, relative rank 1 for the alternating word (1,-1)^r; this lemma generalizes it to nested words of every magnitude and nesting depth, zero entries and every ring with 1.

Its Proposition 24 gives full-rank set-multilinear projections of BE for every path of P_{k,d} over integral domains with at least d^2 2^(k(d+1)) elements; this lemma covers nested words over every ring with 1, F_2 included, with 0/1 coefficients.
That barrier blocks conversions to homogeneous form at cost f(d) s^c; this lemma blocks the direct use of the relative-rank measure on inhomogeneous formulas over F_2.
On charged ternary Tseitin the certificate side already fails: one certificate has small word ranks at every cut; this lemma is the formula side.
